title: acs state fragment for /acs:create-api-contract
description: What THIS skill records: the `states` keys it owns and, when it completes in more than one way, its closed `outcome` vocabulary. The envelope is validated centrally by step-state.schema.json; this fragment is why adding a skill is a directory rather than an edit to a central schema (§4.4).

outcome.description: How the Design run completed (ADR-0134): `contract_written` when the contract-author → contract-reviewer loop wrote the living `lld/<feature>/api/<interface>.md` files and the run record, `type_disabled` when the `api-contract` LLD type is disabled in `design.lld_types`, so nothing was written.
